sql_templates.regime_breadth_query:
SELECT 
                f.trade_date, 
                f.fii_net_today, 
                f.dii_net_today, 
                f.flow_signal, 
                r.regime, 
                r.confidence, 
                b.advances, 
                b.declines, 
                b.ad_signal, 
                i.index_symbol, 
                i.close, 
                i.trend_signal
            FROM 
                signals.fii_dii_flows f
            JOIN 
                signals.regime_history r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
            JOIN 
                breadth.market_daily b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
            JOIN 
                market.index_eod i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
            WHERE 
                f.trade_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days')
                AND i.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
            ORDER BY 
                f.trade_date DESC;

sql_templates.description: Query to fetch VCP breakout stocks with strong fundamentals within last 20 sessions.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_snapshots AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM scores.stage_snapshots
  WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
  AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
  AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
),
latest_vcp_picks AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks
  WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)
)
SELECT
  eod.symbol,
  eod.close AS latest_close,
  snaps.company_name,
  snaps.enhanced_fund_score
FROM
  market.equity_eod eod
JOIN latest_snapshots snaps ON eod.symbol = snaps.symbol
JOIN latest_vcp_picks vcp ON eod.symbol = vcp.symbol
WHERE
  eod.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
AND vcp.vcp_score > 80
ORDER BY vcp.vcp_score DESC, snaps.enhanced_fund_score DESC
LIMIT 10;
